messages.subject: Project Falcon - SSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Please find our mark-up of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement attached (redline against your first draft). Principal changes: founder warranty cap reduced to £3.75m, and the founder non-compete reduced to 18 months. We've left the company cap at £14m. We can discuss the de minimis and basket on a call.

Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP
